description: This file declares functions related to initializing and setting parameters for different convolution, deconvolution, and pooling operations in QNNPACK, a quantized neural network package, within PyTorch.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_conv3d
methods.description: Initializes indirection data for a 3D convolution operation.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_dwconv
methods.description: Initializes indirection data for a depth-wise convolution.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_deconv2d
methods.description: Initializes indirection data for a 2D deconvolution.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_init_maxpool2d
methods.description: Initializes indirection data for a 2D max pooling operation.

methods.name: pytorch_qnnp_indirection_set_step_dimensions
methods.description: Sets step dimensions for the indirection operator.
